#!/usr/bin/env python3
import pathlib, struct, sys

if sys.argv[1] != "--api":
    sys.stderr.write("whole CLI failure packet\n")
    raise SystemExit(17)

def exact(size):
    assert 0 <= size <= 65536
    data = bytearray()
    while len(data) < size:
        part = sys.stdin.buffer.read(size - len(data))
        assert part, "the complete owned API request is required"
        data.extend(part)
    return bytes(data)

def read_bin():
    tag = exact(1)[0]
    width = {0xc4: 1, 0xc5: 2, 0xc6: 4}[tag]
    return exact(int.from_bytes(exact(width), "big"))

def write_bin(body):
    return b"\xc5" + struct.pack(">H", len(body)) + body

assert exact(2) == b"\x93\x01"
method, request = read_bin(), read_bin()
counter = pathlib.Path(__file__).with_name(".api-call-count")
count = int(counter.read_text()) + 1 if counter.exists() else 1
counter.write_text(str(count))
message = (b"whole initial API failure packet" if count % 2 else
           b"whole fallback API failure packet")
sys.stdout.buffer.write(b"\x93\x05" + write_bin(method) + write_bin(message))
sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
# Keep the owned transport open until its actual owner retires it.
sys.stdin.buffer.read()
